definitions.full: H5389. nashin [ נְשִׁין ] noun feminine plural wives (so Zinjirli (Cooke 62.8 ) construct נְשִׁין ᵑ7 נשי, , Syriac , Hebrew נָשִׁים , Arabic on singular see Biblical Hebrew אִשָּׁה , and add Aramaic of Nineveh construct אשת (CIS i.15 ), and Egyptian Aramaic אנתה S-C Pap. D10 +); — plural suffix נְשֵֹׁיהוֺן Dan 6:25 .
